annotation: same host as the clicked tab, ignoring a leading www.

const host = (u) => new URL(u).hostname.replace(/^www\./, "");

annotation: same base domain (last two host labels; crude for co.uk style domains)
code:
const base = (u) => new URL(u).hostname.split(".").slice(-2).join(".");
return base(cmpTab.url) === base(clkTab.url);
